findings: `learner.overview.text` (and the matching `summary.text`) says the alternative proposals picture “a person carrying a load or a sack above 土.” This conflates distinct analyses: the person-carrying account describes a person with a bag, while the sack-and-weight proposal identifies 東 as a sack and 土 as a weight; the cited evidence does not establish that these are one shared construction. Keep them distinct, or summarize them without implying the person account includes 土. Cite the corresponding claims separately.
